title: MetricsIntentQueryRequest
description: Metrics query request (instant). Provide exactly one of intent or queryPlan. The backend compiles the selected source plus bindings to the underlying TSDB query language (e.g., PromQL).

intent.description: Stable curated intent identifier (e.g., `interface.util_pct_p95_5m`, `condition.transitions.rate`). Mutually exclusive with queryPlan.

queryPlan.description: Structured direct metric query plan authored by an agent after metric discovery/validation. Mutually exclusive with intent.

selectors.description: Optional product-level selectors for the request (e.g., `targetId`, `conditionKey`). These are not backend label matchers.

asOf.description: Optional time cursor for snapshot/time-travel mode.
